description: This Kotlin source file defines the DashboardViewModel class, which manages the presentation logic and state for a calculator dashboard UI, including error handling, input validation, and calculation operations.

classes.name: DashboardViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class for managing calculator input, validation, and calculation results, exposing LiveData for UI to observe.

methods.name: onOperation
methods.description: Performs a calculator operation based on input strings, validates input, handles division by zero, and updates LiveData for result and errors.

methods.name: onClear
methods.description: Resets all error and result LiveData to their initial states.
